readings.title: The Terumah
readings.subtitle: Materials for the Dwelling Place
readings.text: [Exodus 25:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, that they take up a contribution for <dn>Me</dn>. From everyone whose heart moves him you shall take up <dn>My</dn> contribution.</dq> [3] <dq>“And this is the contribution which you take up from them: gold, and silver, and bronze,</dq> [4] <dq>and blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,</dq> [5] <dq>and ram skins dyed red, and fine leather, and acacia wood,</dq> [6] <dq>oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,</dq> [7] <dq>shoham stones, and stones to be set in the shoulder garments and in the breastplate.</dq> [8] <dq>“And let them make a sanctuary for <dn>Me</dn>, that <dn>I</dn> may dwell in their midst.</dq> [9] <dq>“According to all that <dn>I</dn> show you – the pattern of the Dwelling Place and the pattern of all its furnishings – make it exactly so.</dq>

readings.title: The Ark of the Witness
readings.subtitle: The Throne of Authority
readings.text: [Exodus 25:10] <dq>“And they shall make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits its length, and a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall overlay it with clean gold, inside and outside you are to overlay it, and shall make on it a moulding of gold all around.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners, two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to lift the ark by them.</dq> [15] <dq>“The poles are to be in the rings of the ark, they are not taken from it.</dq> [16] <dq>“And into the ark you shall put the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall make a lid of atonement of clean gold, two and a half cubits its length and a cubit and a half its width.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make two keruḇim of gold, make them of beaten work at the two ends of the lid of atonement.</dq> [19] <dq>“And make one keruḇ at one end, and the other keruḇ at the other end. Make the keruḇim from the lid of atonement, at its two ends.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the keruḇim shall be spreading out their wings above, covering the lid of atonement with their wings, with their faces toward each other, the faces of the keruḇim turned toward the lid of atonement.</dq> [21] <dq>“And you shall put the lid of atonement on top of the ark, and put into the ark the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [22] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall meet with you there, and from above the lid of atonement, from between the two keruḇim which are on the ark of the Witness, <dn>I</dn> shall speak to you all that <dn>I</dn> command you concerning the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq>

readings.title: The Table of Showbread
readings.subtitle: Provisions in the Presence
readings.text: [Exodus 25:23] <dq>“And you shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits its length, and a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall overlay it with clean gold, and shall make a moulding of gold all around it.</dq> [25] <dq>“And you shall make a rim of a handbreadth all around it, and you shall make a moulding of gold for the rim all around it.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.</dq> [27] <dq>“The rings are close to the rim, as holders for the poles to lift the table.</dq> [28] <dq>“And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be lifted with them.</dq> [29] <dq>“And you shall make its dishes, and its ladles, and its jars, and its bowls for pouring. Make them of clean gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall put the showbread on the table before <dn>Me</dn> continually.</dq>

readings.title: The Menorah
readings.subtitle: Light of the Sanctuary
readings.text: [Exodus 25:31] <dq>“And you shall make a lampstand of clean gold – the lampstand is made of beaten work. Its base and its shaft, its cups, its ornamental knobs and flowers are from it.</dq> [32] <dq>“And six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.</dq> [33] <dq>“Three cups made like almond flowers on one branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower, and three cups made like almond flowers on the other branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower – so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [34] <dq>“And on the lampstand itself four cups made like almond flowers, each with its ornamental knob and flower.</dq> [35] <dq>“And there shall be a knob under the first two branches of the same, and a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [36] <dq>“Their knobs and their branches are from it, all of it one beaten work of clean gold.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make seven lamps for it, and they shall arrange its lamps so that they give light in front of it.</dq> [38] <dq>“And its snuffers and their trays are of clean gold.</dq> [39] <dq>“It is made of a talent of clean gold, with all these utensils.</dq> [40] <dq>“And see that you make them according to the pattern which was shown to you on the mountain.</dq>

readings.title: The Mishkan Construction
readings.subtitle: Curtains, Boards, and the Veil
readings.text: [Exodus 26:1] <dq>“And you shall make the Dwelling Place with ten curtains of fine woven linen, and blue and purple and scarlet material, with keruḇim, the work of a skilled workman you shall make them.</dq> [2] <dq>“The length of each curtain is twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, all the curtains having one measure.</dq> [3] <dq>“Five curtains are joined to each other, and five curtains are joined to each other.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same on the edge of the end curtain in the second set.</dq> [5] <dq>“Make fifty loops in the one curtain, and make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set, the loops being opposite to each other.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make fifty hooks of gold, and join the curtains together with the hooks, and the Dwelling Place shall be one.</dq> [7] <dq>“And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the Dwelling Place, make eleven curtains.</dq> [8] <dq>“The length of each curtain is thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, the eleven curtains having one measure.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall join five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is lowermost in the one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain of the second set.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall make fifty hooks of bronze, and put the hooks into the loops, and join the tent together, and it shall be one.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the overlapping part that is left over of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [13] <dq>“And a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side, of what remains of the length of the curtains of the tent, is to hang over the sides of the Dwelling Place, on this side and on that side, to cover it.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall make a covering of ram skins dyed red for the tent, and a covering of fine leather above that.</dq> [15] <dq>“And for the Dwelling Place you shall make the boards of acacia wood, standing up.</dq> [16] <dq>“Ten cubits is the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.</dq> [17] <dq>“Two tenons in each board for binding one to another. Do the same for all the boards of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make the boards for the Dwelling Place, twenty boards for the south side.</dq> [19] <dq>“And make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.</dq> [20] <dq>“And for the second side of the Dwelling Place, the north side, there are twenty boards,</dq> [21] <dq>and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under each of the boards.</dq> [22] <dq>“And for the back of the Dwelling Place, westward, you shall make six boards.</dq> [23] <dq>“And you shall make two boards for the two back corners of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [24] <dq>“And they are double beneath, and similarly they are complete to the top, to the one ring. So it is for both of them, they are for the two corners.</dq> [25] <dq>“And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets, two sockets under the first board, and two sockets under each of the boards.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards on one side of the Dwelling Place,</dq> [27] <dq>and five bars for the boards on the other side of the Dwelling Place, and five bars for the boards of the side of the Dwelling Place, for the back, westward.</dq> [28] <dq>“And the middle bar shall pass through the midst of the boards from end to end.</dq> [29] <dq>“And overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlay the bars with gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall raise up the Dwelling Place according to its pattern which you were shown on the mountain.</dq> [31] <dq>“And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman, made with keruḇim.</dq> [32] <dq>“And you shall put it on four columns of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks of gold, upon four sockets of silver.</dq> [33] <dq>“And you shall hang the veil from the hooks, and shall bring the ark of the Witness there, behind the veil. And the veil shall separate for you between the Set-apart Place and the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [34] <dq>“And you shall put the lid of atonement upon the ark of the Witness in the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [35] <dq>“And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the Dwelling Place toward the south, and put the table on the north side.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall make a screen for the door of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make for the screen five columns of acacia, and overlay them with gold, their hooks of gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.</dq>

readings.title: The Altar of Bronze
readings.subtitle: The Place of Sacrifice
readings.text: [Exodus 27:1] <dq>“And you shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide – the altar is square – and its height three cubits.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make its horns on its four corners, its horns are of the same, and overlay it with bronze.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall make its pots to take away its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its fire holders. Make all its utensils of bronze.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make a grating for it, a network of bronze, and on the network you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall put it under the rim of the altar beneath, so that the network is to the middle of the altar.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.</dq> [7] <dq>“And the poles shall be put in the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar to lift it.</dq> [8] <dq>“Make it hollow with boards. As <dn>he</dn> showed you on the mountain, so they are to do.</dq>

readings.title: The Courtyard
readings.subtitle: Boundaries and the Eternal Light
readings.text: [Exodus 27:9] <dq>“And you shall make the courtyard of the Dwelling Place: for the south side there are hangings for the courtyard of fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long for one side.</dq> [10] <dq>“And its twenty columns and their twenty sockets are bronze. The hooks of the columns and their bands are silver.</dq> [11] <dq>“And so for the north side in length, hangings one hundred cubits long, and its twenty columns and their twenty sockets are bronze, and the hooks of the columns and their bands are silver.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the width of the courtyard on the west side is hangings of fifty cubits, their columns ten and their sockets ten.</dq> [13] <dq>“And the width of the courtyard on the east side, eastward, is fifty cubits.</dq> [14] <dq>“And the hangings on one side of the gate are fifteen cubits, their columns three and their sockets three.</dq> [15] <dq>“And on the other side are hangings of fifteen cubits, their columns three and their sockets three.</dq> [16] <dq>“And for the gate of the courtyard a screen of twenty cubits, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver, their columns four and their sockets four.</dq> [17] <dq>“All the columns around the courtyard have bands of silver, their hooks are silver and their sockets are bronze.</dq> [18] <dq>“The length of the courtyard is one hundred cubits, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of fine woven linen, and their sockets are bronze.</dq> [19] <dq>“All the utensils of the Dwelling Place for all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, are of bronze.</dq> [20] <dq>“And you, you are to command the children of Yisra’ĕl to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.</dq> [21] <dq>“In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the Witness, Aharon and his sons are to tend it from evening until morning before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – a law forever to their generations on behalf of the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq>

readings.title: Garments of Glory
readings.subtitle: Set-Apart Attire for the Priesthood
readings.text: [Exodus 28:1] <dq>“And you, bring near Aharon your brother and his sons with him, from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, for serving as priest to <dn>Me</dn>: Aharon, Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu, Elʽazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aharon.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make set-apart garments for Aharon your brother, for esteem and for comeliness.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you, speak to all the wise of heart, whom <dn>I</dn> have filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they make the garments of Aharon, to set him apart, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>“And these are the garments which they make: a breastplate, and a shoulder garment, and a robe, an embroidered long shirt, a turban, and a girdle. And they shall make set-apart garments for Aharon your brother and his sons, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>“And they shall take the gold, and the blue and the purple and the scarlet material, and the fine linen.</dq> [6] <dq>“And they shall make the shoulder garment of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman.</dq> [7] <dq>“It is to have two shoulder pieces joined at its two edges, and so it is joined together.</dq> [8] <dq>“And the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, which is on it, is of the same workmanship, made of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall take two shoham stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Yisra’ĕl:</dq> [10] <dq>“Six of their names on one stone, and the remaining six names on the other stone, according to their birth.</dq> [11] <dq>“With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Yisra’ĕl. Set them in settings of gold.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall put the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment as stones of remembrance for the sons of Yisra’ĕl. And Aharon shall bear their names before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on his two shoulders for a remembrance.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make settings of gold,</dq> [14] <dq>and two chains of clean gold like a cord, of braided work. And you shall put the braided chains on the settings.</dq> [15] <dq>“And you shall make the breastplate of right-ruling, a work of a skilled workman, like the work of the shoulder garment. Make it of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen.</dq> [16] <dq>“It is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its width.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall put settings of stones in it, four rows of stones: The first row is a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;</dq> [18] <dq>and the second row is a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;</dq> [19] <dq>and the third row is a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;</dq> [20] <dq>and the fourth row is a beryl, and a shoham, and a jasper. They are set in gold settings.</dq> [21] <dq>“And the stones are according to the names of the sons of Yisra’ĕl, twelve according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, each one with its own name, for the twelve tribes.</dq> [22] <dq>“And you shall make braided chains of corded work for the breastplate at the ends, of clean gold.</dq> [23] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold for the breastplate, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.</dq> [25] <dq>“And the other two ends of the two cords you fasten to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment, at the front.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which is on the inner side of the shoulder garment.</dq> [27] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment, underneath and to the front, at its seam above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment.</dq> [28] <dq>“And they bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the shoulder garment with a blue cord, so that it is above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, and that the breastplate does not come loose from the shoulder garment.</dq> [29] <dq>“And Aharon shall bear the names of the sons of Yisra’ĕl on the breastplate of right-ruling over his heart, when he goes into the Set-apart Place, for a remembrance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> continually.</dq> [30] <dq>“And into the breastplate of right-ruling you shall put the Urim and the Tummim, and they shall be on the heart of Aharon when he goes in before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And Aharon shall bear the right-ruling of the children of Yisra’ĕl on his heart before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> continually.</dq> [31] <dq>“And you shall make the robe of the shoulder garment all of blue.</dq> [32] <dq>“And the opening for his head shall be in the middle of it, a woven binding all around its opening, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it does not tear.</dq> [33] <dq>“And on its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet material, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:</dq> [34] <dq>“a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.</dq> [35] <dq>“And it shall be upon Aharon to serve, and the sound of it shall be heard when he goes into the Set-apart Place before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and when he comes out, that he does not die.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall make a plate of clean gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet: SET-APART TO <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall put it on a blue cord, and it shall be on the turban – it is to be on the front of the turban.</dq> [38] <dq>“And it shall be on the forehead of Aharon, and Aharon shall bear the guilt of the set-apart gifts which the children of Yisra’ĕl set apart in all their set-apart gifts. And it shall be on his forehead continually, that they may be accepted before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [39] <dq>“And you shall weave the long shirt of fine linen, and shall make the turban of fine linen, and you shall make the girdle of woven work.</dq> [40] <dq>“And for Aharon’s sons you make long shirts, and you shall make girdles for them, and you shall make turbans for them, for esteem and comeliness.</dq> [41] <dq>“And you shall put them on Aharon your brother and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and ordain them, and set them apart, and they shall serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [42] <dq>“And make linen trousers for them to cover their nakedness, reaching from the waist to the thighs.</dq> [43] <dq>“And they shall be on Aharon and on his sons when they come into the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near the altar to serve in the Set-apart Place, that they do not bear crookedness and die – a law forever to him and his seed after him.</dq>
